harvest.method: One throwaway single-step event per zone, written to 2027-12-01, read back, and deleted. For a single constant step the platform's `average_watts` is the resolved target in watts.
harvest.note: The two percentage controls show the zone path is not the percentage path: Z2 and 55-75% agree, Z6 and 120-150% do not, because the zone path converts each bound to watts before taking the midpoint.
